name: P-I-R-@-T™ Tools – AI Discovery Toolkit
author: Ilja Hynek

sections.description:
P-I-R-@-T™ Tools – AI Discovery Toolkit is an independently usable FREE edition derived from the compatible historical 6.18.19 baseline.

The FREE package provides AI discovery file generation, LLMS outputs, classic XML sitemap support, robots controls, basic AI crawler recognition and local history, AI Submission Center / IndexNow basics, settings backup and basic diagnostics. Executable PRO providers, PRO-only advanced audits and the PRO industry library are physically separated from the FREE ZIP.

Owned historical data produced by a compatible PRO installation remains intentionally recognizable through edition-neutral retained-data access so administrators can inspect, export or delete their data without reinstalling PRO.

The plugin creates no custom database tables. Core local processing does not send website content to external generative-AI services. Optional submission functionality follows explicit administrator configuration and action.

User-facing help supports Czech, Slovak, German and US English, selected from the WordPress administration locale with English fallback.

Supported Languages

P-I-R-@-T™ Tools – AI Discovery Toolkit includes built-in multilingual support:

  • English (EN)
  • Čeština – Czech (CS)
  • Slovenčina – Slovak (SK)
  • Deutsch – German (DE)

The plugin administration interface automatically adapts to the WordPress user language.

No additional language plugins or manual configuration are required.

English is used as the fallback language for all other languages.

External Services

Core discovery-file generation and local diagnostics do not require an external AI service or a remote account. The following third-party integrations are optional; the administrator initiates a submission from AI Submission Center. These services receive the information listed below when the relevant action is performed. Review their terms and privacy policies before using them.

Google Search Console (optional)

When an administrator submits a sitemap to Google, the plugin sends the configured Search Console property identifier and sitemap URL to the Google Search Console API (www.googleapis.com) and authenticates that request with the access token supplied by the administrator. The request is made when the administrator submits the Google form; it is not required for normal plugin operation. The configured property and submission result are stored in local WordPress options.
Service: https://search.google.com/search-console/
API terms: https://developers.google.com/webmaster-tools/v1/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Bing Webmaster Tools (optional)

The Bing Webmaster API key is optional. FREE discovery files and the separate IndexNow integration work without it. Saving a key does not submit anything: the administrator must manually select an XML sitemap and submit it from AI Submission Center. The site must be verified and publicly indexable. Key setup: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/bingwebmaster/getting-access

When an administrator submits a sitemap to Bing, the plugin sends the configured site URL and sitemap/feed URL to Bing Webmaster Tools (ssl.bing.com); the administrator-configured API key is included in the HTTPS API request. The request is triggered by the Bing submission action and is not required for discovery-file generation. The configured site URL and submission result are stored in local WordPress options; API credentials are stored in WordPress settings using the plugin’s credential-handling mechanism.
Service: https://www.bing.com/webmasters/
Terms: https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement
Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

IndexNow (optional)

When an administrator submits URLs to IndexNow, the plugin sends the site’s hostname, IndexNow key, key-file location, and selected on-site URLs to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow. An administrator can separately verify the public key file: that verification requests the key-file URL hosted on the same WordPress site. Creating and serving the IndexNow verification key file makes the key publicly accessible by design. The submission is not required for normal local plugin operation.
Service and protocol: https://www.indexnow.org/
Protocol terms and provider documentation: https://www.indexnow.org/documentation
Microsoft privacy (one participating provider): https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

These optional submissions do not guarantee crawling, indexing, search rankings or citations by AI systems. Administrators are responsible for having a lawful basis for transmitting submitted URLs and related site identifiers to the respective providers.

Upgrade to PRO

The FREE edition works independently. Advanced PRO functionality is provided by a separately distributed add-on. The optional information link appears only inside this plugin’s own admin Help/Comparison screen; it points to https://www.reklamni-poradenstvi.cz/ by default. The information URL may be customized by the site owner. No storefront checkout URL or purchase button is preconfigured until the seller publishes a specific product page. No frontend promotional credit or unsolicited dashboard notice is added.
sections.installation:
1. Back up the WordPress website.
  2. Upload the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Review Diagnostics and storage status.
  5. Configure the required FREE modules.
  6. Generate discovery files manually before enabling any supported schedule.
sections.faq:
Is PRO code hidden inside this FREE ZIP?

No. Executable PRO provider implementations, PRO-only advanced audits and the PRO industry library are physically separated from the FREE package.

Can I still access historical PRO data after removing PRO?

The edition-neutral retained-data layer is designed to keep owned historical datasets recognizable for bounded read/export/delete operations without loading their original PRO producer classes.

Does the plugin send content to external AI services?

No external generative-AI service is required for the FREE edition. Optional submission functionality follows its own explicit administrator configuration and action.

Which languages are supported?

User-facing help and localized administration text support Czech, Slovak, German and US English. Unsupported administration locales fall back to English.
sections.changelog:
6.19.9

  • 26 November 2026: Approved by the WordPress.org Plugins Team.
  • First official WordPress.org release.
  • Includes WPCS security improvements and validated release package.

6.19.8

  • 22 November 2026 review candidate: refreshed build metadata, safer robots and public-root handling, and private filesystem guard; approval pending.
  • WordPress.org FREE distribution uses standard package checksums and externally archived build evidence; no publisher-signature files or runtime publisher-signature verification are bundled. PRO retains independently signed publisher evidence and licencing.

6.19.7

  • Final WordPress.org release with stable localized release copy, current crawler documentation links, source copyright notices and an independently verifiable release manifest.

6.19.6

  • WordPress.org submission compatibility: the canonical FREE plugin no longer changes the activation state of the historical ai-seo-toolkit plugin.
  • If the historical FREE plugin is still active, canonical FREE pauses before duplicate runtime loading and asks an administrator to deactivate the older plugin manually.
  • Settings, retained data, storage identifiers and both plugin file trees are preserved; after manual legacy deactivation the existing idempotent upgrade path resumes canonical FREE normally.
  • No PRO, licensing, classifier, scoring, regional-authority, telemetry or update-channel behavior is added or changed.

6.19.5

  • Stable promotion of the operator-accepted DEV175 fix: repairs direct access to hidden admin tools (Robots.txt, AI Agent Monitoring, AI Index & Feed, Search Console, Submission Center, export validation and operational log) while keeping them out of the visible submenu.
  • Preserves canonical FREE installation identity pirat-ai-discovery-toolkit and internal ai-seo-toolkit admin-menu compatibility.
  • PRO 0.1.24, classifiers, scoring and regional authority are unchanged.

6.19.4

  • Stable migration fix: activating the canonical WordPress.org package while the historical ai-seo-toolkit FREE plugin is still active now deactivates only the legacy plugin entry before the canonical runtime boots.
  • Prevents duplicate AIST_* constant/class loading and activation-time unexpected output during legacy-to-canonical migration.
  • Settings, retained data, storage identifiers and legacy plugin files are preserved; no PRO, classifier, scoring or regional-authority logic is changed.

6.19.3

  • Canonical WordPress.org identity aligned to pirat-ai-discovery-toolkit; legacy admin routes and persistent-data identifiers remain unchanged for compatibility.
  • Stable security and reliability release. Bing API credentials fail closed when authenticated encryption is unavailable or invalid; legacy reversible/plain storage is not treated as usable credentials.
  • Hardened JSON encoding, permalink/query edge cases and retained-data boundaries while preserving the independently usable FREE feature set.
  • Release validation completed with WordPress-aware static analysis, dependency/security checks, mutation testing, role/capability checks, malformed-input fuzzing, bounded load testing, reversible lifecycle testing and OWASP ZAP.
  • Stable promotion from the exact validated 6.19.3 release candidate changes release metadata and documentation only; no functional algorithm change was introduced after acceptance.

6.19.2

  • Add an optional, contextual admin-only information link for the separately distributed PRO add-on. A direct purchase button is shown only when an administrator/developer explicitly configures a real checkout URL; no e-commerce page is assumed. Core FREE algorithms are unchanged.

6.19.1

  • WordPress.org submission candidate: documents optional external services and privacy. No runtime changes.

6.19.0

  • CZ Stable final after the PHP matrix, WordPress 7.1.3 Plugin Check zero errors/zero warnings and controlled operator acceptance.
  • Runtime algorithms unchanged; fixed four-language PHP verification text (verified 8.2–8.5, requires >=8.0). PRO remains separately versioned.

6.19.0-dev160-rc1

  • DEV160: CZ release candidate. Version, translated FREE docs and Help metadata synchronized. Functional PHP code unchanged from DEV157.
  • Requires new exact-package PHP/Plugin Check and manual WordPress installation evidence before stable release.

6.18.31-rc5

  • Dev131: avoids open_basedir warnings when testing private storage outside the allowed PHP filesystem scope.
  • Falls back to the existing protected uploads storage when parent paths are inaccessible.
  • Changes no storage data, detector authority, scheduling or network behavior.

6.18.31-rc4

  • Dev126 Plugin Check hotfix candidate.
  • Aligns the WordPress.org Stable tag with the actual FREE plugin version.
  • Updates release/version metadata only; no runtime, detector, authority, storage, scheduling or network behavior changes.

6.18.29-rc1

  • Dev94 RC1 install-validation candidate for controlled PIRAT test-site deployment.
  • Carries the validated CZ/SK/DE/EN classification and detection help into FREE.
  • Pairs with PRO 0.1.0-dev94-rc1; no detector authority, scoring, storage, scheduling, remote-request or edition-boundary change.
  • Regional classification remains shadow-only; legacy_profile_detector remains authoritative.

6.18.28

  • Post-point-10 Help metadata cleanup candidate.
  • Replaces obsolete June–July 2026 development wording and obsolete validation-phase labels in user-facing Help/status text.
  • Pairs with PRO dev13, which fixes the deferred CZ-NACE administration rendering fault.
  • No intended changes to audit algorithms, scoring, storage semantics, external requests, scheduling, or FREE/PRO capability ownership.

6.18.27

  • Phase 3F.9 Plugin Check hardening candidate.
  • Escapes localized admin status output and wp_die() messages reported by WordPress Plugin Check.
  • No intended changes to audit algorithms, scoring, storage semantics, external requests, scheduling, or FREE/PRO capability ownership.

6.18.26

  • Phase 3F.5 documentation candidate.
  • Aligns four language documentation files and release-facing text across CZ/SK/DE/EN.
  • Replaces stale release-status wording while preserving deferred Help metadata for the post-point-10 cleanup.
  • No intended change to audit algorithms, scoring, storage, external requests or FREE/PRO feature ownership.

6.18.25

  • Phase 3F.4 terminology candidate.
  • Locks current user-facing product, edition and module terminology across FREE and PRO.

6.18.24

  • Completes source/static localization coverage for CZ/SK/DE/EN and English fallback.

6.18.23

  • Quality-gate hotfix and help cleanup, including removal of obsolete ai-sitemap.xsl wording.

6.18.22

  • FREE physical-candidate milestone used for live Plugin Check validation.

6.18.20

  • Plugin Check remediation candidate derived from the frozen historical 6.18.19 baseline and deterministic FREE 6.18.19-free1 package.

6.18.19

  • First offline FREE package candidate derived from the historical 6.18.19 upstream.
  • Physically separates PRO provider implementations and the PRO-only industry profile library from FREE.

screenshots.caption: AI Discovery Toolkit Dashboard – AI file generation, XML and JSON validation, and file status overview.
AI Files – Structured knowledge graph, product feeds, FAQ feeds, and dedicated exports for ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.
AI Crawler Access – Real-world AI agent monitoring with traffic statistics, crawler classifications, and visited URLs.
AI Crawler Access – Detailed GPTBot activity and automated crawler request history.
AI Submission Center – Sitemap submission to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, IndexNow integration, and sitemap splitting.
Generated llms.txt – An example of structured website discovery information for AI systems and large language models (URLs anonymized).
Reports and Exports – Settings import and export, AI agent history, technical reports, and backup management.
Built-in Help – Plugin documentation, multilingual support, recommended workflows, and feature overview.
FREE Build Information – Transparent release metadata, informational build fingerprint, and independent verification information.
